query: SELECT d.tenant_id, d.day FROM tenants AS t JOIN tenant_spend_days AS d ON d.tenant_id = t.id WHERE t.state = 'deleted' AND t.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM namespaces AS n WHERE n.tenant_id = t.id AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED
